entities.name: Alfredo Zayas y Alfonso
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alfredo de Zayas y Alfonso, usually known as Alfredo de Zayas under Spanish naming customs and also known as Alfredo Zayas, was a Cuban lawyer, poet and political figure who was President of Cuba.
